_context.close: Accessible label of the button that closes a dialog, a sheet or a panel.
_context.chat.actionApproval.decline: Button that refuses the action the coworker asks to run.
_context.chat.approval.title: {label} is the name of the tool that asks for approval.
_context.chat.approval.responded: {choice} is the raw choice code (once, session, always, deny), kept untranslated.
_context.chat.approval.choices.session: Approve for the rest of this chat session.
_context.chat.question.somethingElse: Last option of a multiple-choice question: opens a free-text field to give another answer.
_context.chat.question.skip: Skips the current question without answering.
_context.chat.reasoning.thoughtFor: {duration} is a short elapsed time such as 12s or 1m 4s.
_context.chat.reasoning.thought: Past tense: the model has finished thinking.
_context.chat.secret.storedAs: {key} is the name of the environment variable the value is stored under.
_context.chat.skillProposal.question: The coworker proposes to remember a rule it noticed.
_context.chat.skillProposal.no: Button that refuses to remember the rule.
_context.chat.table.groupedBy: {column} is the name of the database column a kanban board is grouped by.
_context.chat.table.more: Under a kanban column: how many more cards are not shown.
_context.canvas.recenter: Tooltip of the button that brings the board back to its default view.
_context.consent.short: Mobile cookie banner. <policy> wraps a link to the cookie policy page.
_context.consent.long: Desktop cookie banner. <policy> wraps a link to the cookie policy page.
_context.experts.wizard.step: Small label above the title of each step of the profile wizard.
_context.experts.preview.hire: Button on an expert's public profile to hire them.
_context.experts.card.status: Label on a holographic profile card, followed by the profile type (Studio, Freelancer).
_context.experts.availability.tooltip: {label} is the availability (Available, Not available), {hint} its short explanation.
_context.experts.images.drop: Overlay shown while a file is dragged over the upload tile.
_context.foreman.tabs.assistant: Tab of the Chief of Staff chat where you ask it questions.
_context.foreman.periods.running: Heading of the routines that are running right now.
_context.foreman.routines.runningMinutes: A routine running for {minutes} minutes; m is the short unit for minutes.
_context.foreman.routines.startsInMinutes: A routine that starts in {minutes} minutes; m is the short unit for minutes.
_context.foreman.routines.runningJustNow: A routine that started less than a minute ago.
_context.foreman.routines.pause: Accessible label of the switch that pauses the routine {name}.
_context.foreman.orbLabel: Accessible label of the round button that opens the Chief of Staff chat.
_context.forms.optional: Shown next to the title of a form field that can be left empty.
_context.forms.select: Placeholder of a dropdown with nothing picked yet.
_context.monitoring.live: Small badge: the data updates in real time.
_context.inbox.sections.headsUps: Section of notifications a coworker flagged for you to read.
_context.inbox.pillLabel: Accessible label of the notifications pill. {summary} is a short count such as 2 need you · 1 done.
_context.inbox.needsYouCount: How many notifications need the user.
_context.inbox.running: <n> wraps the number. Tasks being run by coworkers right now.
_context.richText.linkPrompt: Browser prompt asking for the address of a link.
_context.richText.heading: Toolbar button: makes the line a heading.
_context.theme.options.system: Follow the operating system's light or dark setting.
_context.monitoring.runs.tokens: {tokens} is an already formatted number of tokens.
_context.monitoring.usage.cached: Input tokens read from the model provider's cache.
_context.monitoring.chart.other: Chart series grouping every smaller category.
_context.monitoring.agentStatus.waiting_human: A coworker waiting for a person to answer.
_context.newAgent.create: Button that creates the coworker named {name}.
_context.newAgent.pickedApps: Accessible label: {apps} is a comma-separated list of app names.
_context.newAgent.or: Separator between two alternatives: pick a suggestion, or browse templates.
_context.newAgent.schedule.everyDays: {days} is a list of weekday names (Monday, Tuesday and Friday), {time} a 24-hour time such as 9:00.
_context.newAgent.schedule.onDemand: The coworker runs only when the user asks it to, never on a schedule.
_context.newAgent.schedule.button: Button that opens the schedule planner.
_context.newAgent.schedule.readFromDescription: Under a timing that was understood from the job description the user typed.
_context.newAgent.appsPicker.limit: {max} is the maximum number of apps a new coworker can start with.
_context.newAgent.forYou.closeToIdea: Heading above suggested coworkers similar to what the user is typing.
_context.isoGrid.board: Accessible name of the isometric board where coworkers are laid out as blocks.
_context.isoGrid.addBlock: Tooltip of the + handle on the side of a Box: adds space to it on that side.
_context.isoGrid.status.waiting_human: Status of a coworker waiting for the user to answer.
_context.isoGrid.status.disabled: Status of a coworker that is switched off.
_context.templateStory.states.approval: Badge on a demo card: the coworker waits for the user.
_context.templateStory.edit: Fake button on a demo card, next to Approve.
_context.primitives.carousel.goTo: Accessible label of a pagination dot. {label} names what the carousel holds (Coworkers), {index} the card number.
_context.primitives.carousel.previous: {label} names what the carousel holds, such as Coworkers.
_context.forms.remove: Accessible label of the cross that removes {item} from a multiple choice.
_context.foreman.agentPicker.openTab: {tab} is the name of a coworker panel tab (Skills, Schedules), {name} the coworker's name.
_context.experts.card.namePlaceholder: Shown on a profile card before a name is typed.
_context.experts.card.rolePlaceholder: Shown on a profile card before a role is typed. Rerun is the brand.
_context.isoGrid.countdown.minutes: Very short countdown to a coworker's next run, on a tiny badge: keep the one-letter unit (m for minutes).
_context.isoGrid.status.paused: Status of a coworker whose workspace is paused (unsubscribed): its machine is archived.
_context.isoGrid.status.restoring: Status of a coworker while its paused workspace is being brought back.
_context.isoGrid.untitledBox: Name shown on a Box (a group of coworkers on the board) that has no name.
_context.isoGrid.tileAria: Screen reader label of a coworker block on the board. {name} is the coworker, {state} its status word, {toHandle} how many conversations wait on the user, {results} how many finished results are unread.
_context.newAgent.appsPicker.categories: Filter chips over a list of apps a coworker can use: the kind of app.
